title: tanacetum atkinsonii
intro: Tanacetum atkinsonii, commonly known as Atkinson's tansy or Mountain tansy, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help reduce inflammation, relieve digestive issues, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetum atkinsonii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, essential oils, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
